text: Entry Requirements Applicants must be a non-Chinese citizen and be in good health. Age between 18 and 25. HSK 4 above 180. Chinese was the instruction language in high school. Interview above 60. According to the regulations of the Ministry of Education of China, those who immigrated to other countries from the Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao or Taiwan and are applying to study at UPC as international students, should meet the following additional requirements. The applicants must hold valid passport or other relevant internationally recognized documents for at least 4 years. Meanwhile, in the latest 4 years (by each April 30th of the year of university registration), the applicants must have lived overseas for 2 years. Living overseas for 9 months can be converted to 1 year, which is subject to the exit-entry stamp on visa.
